interpretation_limits: This does not prove convergence or stable method superiority.
The individual-task energy bound is optimistic and does not predict every queueing or energy outcome. Missing messages are not measured zero energy.
The routing/publication values are reconstructed from causal recorded traces, not directly saved full input tensors.
Exposure to blocked slots is descriptive; no alternate routing or CPU policy was simulated to estimate recoverable task counts.
An earlier energy-blockage time does not by itself establish a reward or source-code fault.
No claim is made that32k will correct energy-aware behavior.
recommendation: Keep the current C scientific configuration frozen and use a bounded training-length diagnostic as the next experiment, with completion and these energy-risk metrics evaluated together. Do not promote current C16k to a mature final model or change reward/masks on this evidence alone.
